axis.description: An integer, the axis to reduce across. Default to 0.
constraints: If axis is None, the operation reduces across all axes.

output_type.description: An optional output dtype (`tf.int32` or `tf.int64`). Defaults to `tf.int64`.
constraints: output_type must be either tf.int32 or tf.int64.
The returned tensor contains the indices with the largest value across axes of a tensor.
In case of identity, returns the smallest index.
If there are ties for the maximum value, the smallest index is returned.
